_description: Native gemini_simulator project file for a geothermal doublet's surface + secondary network (Separator -> FilterA -> HeatExchanger -> FilterB, with Boiler/CHP on the secondary side). Every value here is already in the units gemini_model's components expect (see '_units' below); edit this file directly to describe your own plant.

_units.all components: flow rates in SI [m3/s], pressure [bar] (surface network) or [Pa] (heat exchanger/boiler/chp inputs are still bar for pressure -- see each component's own docstring), temperature [C], caloric_value [J/kg]. The only components still working in m3/h are producer_well/injector_well (well/reservoir models, unchanged); the surface chain converts to/from m3/h exactly once at each of those two boundaries.

producer_well._description: Producer-side reservoir/well/ESP, nodal-solved for its primary flow rate from the fixed wellhead pressure/temperature boundary inputs below. See gemini_simulator.well_components.ProducerWell.

parameters._trajectory_table_description: Cumulative MD (measured depth)/TVD (true vertical depth)/ID (inner diameter) survey stations, station 0 = wellhead (MD=TVD=0); this well is fully vertical, so TVD tracks MD exactly at every station.

injector_well._description: Injector-side reservoir/well, nodal-solved for the wellhead (surface) pressure needed to inject the producer well's (already-solved) flow rate back into the reservoir, plus the injector pump that boosts the surface network's return water up to that pressure. See gemini_simulator.well_components.InjectorWell.

parameters._trajectory_table_description: Cumulative MD/TVD/ID survey stations, station 0 = wellhead (MD=TVD=0); this well is fully vertical, so TVD tracks MD exactly at every station.

secondary_splitter._description: Splits the secondary network's total flow between the HEX+Boiler branch (output_0, fraction 'v', which continues in series through heat_exchanger into boiler) and the CHP branch (output_1, fraction '1-v', which bypasses heat_exchanger entirely and feeds chp directly).

gas_splitter._description: Splits the separator's co-produced gas mass flow (gas_mass_flow_rate) between Boiler (output_0, fraction 'u' = burner_modulation) and CHP (output_1, fraction '1-u').

water_mixer._description: Recombines boiler's and chp's water outlets (flow + temperature) into a single water flow/temperature, using a flow-weighted average of the two outlet temperatures.

boundary_inputs._description: Total secondary network flow rate, 140 m3/h converted to m3/s (140/3600).
